message: Field "T.a": @default(dbgenerated()) with no expression is not supported yet on a required field, because without a column default Prisma 8 requires the value on create. Either remove the @default, which makes Prisma 7's next migration drop the column default (ALTER COLUMN ... DROP DEFAULT) and both clients require the value on create, or write the column's database default as @default(dbgenerated("<expression>")), which Prisma 7's next migration sets on the column.
